notes.title: A New Extra Boss Shoots In!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, dev here! Apologies for the delay, but the update for Elite Exorcist Miko's next Extra Stage is now available! [b]Hoshimachi Suisei Alter[/b] arrives as a new Extra Boss, an optional, higher-difficulty battle intended for players looking to put their skills to the test! Check out the video below for a preview of what to expect (or don't, if you prefer to go in blind)!

[previewyoutube=gOLtOxoXf1A;full][/previewyoutube]
The new Extra Stage where you'll find her comes with a few differences compared to the existing Extra Stage. First off, the unlock requirements! You won't need to obtain a crown this time, but there is a different test you'll need to overcome: [b]defeat the standard Suisei boss within 1 minute[/b]! This can be done in either a Main Expedition or Boss Rush. Make good use of Combo and heavy-hitting Scrolls to blaze through the fight lightning-fast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/8e5c39ee6cc688b97b81aa187dbc88fbf11096c9.png[/img]
Once this is achieved, Suisei will talk to you upon returning to the Shrine, and give you a new Key Item, the [b]Stellar Engine[/b]! Equipping this item will grant you access to the new Extra Stage, [b]Midnight Highway[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/39487b4731145194581392fd05e78e5e9b6f46e2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/b01dec2007d4378f5b141c7736c57ca40f13957e.png[/img]
The item also introduces the stage's unique mechanic: [b]in exchange for completely disabling the use of Scrolls, your Energy recharge rate will increase drastically as long as you have Heat to spare[/b]! Without your Scrolls to rely on to deal damage or get out of tough spots, you'll need to make the most of your 3 combat Styles' unique abilities, which are now much easier to use thanks to your fast Energy recovery! Dash through danger, erase tight bullet formations, and keep up the pressure to fight your way to victory!

Once it's unlocked, you can also bring the Stellar Engine with you on Main Expeditions! Give it a try for a different gameplay experience!

Along with the new Extra Stage, a button exclusive to Extra Stages has been added to the Pause menu and Expedition End screen that allows you to restart the stage instantly, without needing to repeat Amezon Delivery!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/5569f10ea9086ce14fb4e4abfbff282b7ada6711.png[/img]
This update also comes with other changes, including the usual bug fixes and balance adjustments. One major change is a rework of the rewards system! Material rewards are no longer generated upon completing a stage. Instead, they'll drop from enemies and bosses as objects to pick up! The purpose of this change is to make material acquisition less ambiguous. Some existing equipment related to obtaining materials have also been updated alongside this change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/3bd906b3fda4284569a4ae9b1348e3cedf45526c.png[/img]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3040560/announcements/detail/515218958901575775]Check out the patch notes for more detailed information on all changes and additions![/url]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
The next update will be another major content update, adding a new stage, [b]Stage 3C[/b] and several bosses to complete the 3rd stage tier and advance the main story! Of course, new equipment items will be added as well! I don't have much to reveal or a release date estimate for this update just yet, but I'll be giving more information as completion progresses!

There probably won't be major system changes in the next update, but I'm currently brainstorming a rework of the Amezon Delivery system that grants additional deliveries based on attaining certain skill-based goals/bonuses during gameplay. This would likely be implemented with the 4th stage tier.

But for now, if you're up for a challenge, do give the new Extra Stage a try! A lot of thought went into designing this boss battle, so I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: The Makai Stage Update is Here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, dev here! I'm very glad to announce that the first major content update for Elite Exorcist Miko, the Makai Stage update, is finally available for you to play! As I previously mentioned, I originally intended to release this update back in April, but personal circumstances made it difficult to finish by that time. I'm happy to say that things are back on track, so hopefully development should go more smoothly going forward! But for now, check out this trailer for a preview of what's included in this update!

[previewyoutube=S4RoS-8h2S0;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3040560/view/515211349279639204][b]You can check out the patch notes[/b][/url] for a detailed list of all changes, but I'll go over the major points here!

[h3]New Stage, New Enemies, New Bosses![/h3]
Makai Stage, or Stage 3B, brings with it several new enemy types as well [b]4 new Bosses — Choco, Towa, Ayame and Shion[/b]! This stage is on par with the Medieval Stage in difficulty, so be sure to prepare yourself with Offerings and equipment before visiting the demon realm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/8345c35d999dfb644c922f8f30a9eb87b3a9de69.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/b214bc27dba85e6ad169a38e549c851ca585e01e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/206f165591dcf6d1e5704d40ebfd1b8a9edf7464.png[/img]
[h3]New Equipment![/h3]
14 new equipment items have been added to spice up your builds! From unorthodox Talisman Attacks (or even none at all) to powerful new Scrolls, I hope you'll enjoy the new possibilities these items have to offer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/5f08159298681f823c209783568cf264f97de890.png[/img]
[h3]2nd Talisman Slot![/h3]
You can now equip a second Talisman after unlocking the newly added slot in Offerings! This Talisman will take effect when using Slow, giving you more flexibility in synergizing equipment and adapting to different situations! You can still use a single Talisman as before if you prefer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/1902a6bf6d7d3d7e95eb93e1c052921e89b3450e.png[/img]
[h3]New Settings![/h3]
In addition to new submenus for Display Settings and Assist Options, many new settings have been added to allow you to further customize your experience. Don't like all those rings and arrows around you? Feel free to turn them off completely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/da4531705ea2bcb432dfe060f9df624eca42d19d.png[/img]
[h3]Stage Skip for GPS Navigator![/h3]
Crown hunters rejoice! Like with Amelia's Pocket Watch, you can now use Holo Essence to skip directly to a marked boss's stage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/46403b6c6449dde351bd53d7624bb719c29f08ec.png[/img]
[h3]Gambler's Omikuji Rework![/h3]
The effect of this craftable Key Item has been revamped! Equipping this item will now randomize your starting equipment and disable rerolls, in exchange for 3 additional Amezon Deliveries! This aims to make the item a more appealing option for players looking for a bit more unpredictability in their runs.

[h3]Status Effect Improvements![/h3]
Burn and Poison now deal more damage and are easier to inflict on a Boss repeatedly, while status effect buildup in general now decays slower.

[h3]Boss Adjustments![/h3]
Several Bosses have received changes to make them a bit easier to deal with, while a few other Bosses have received buffs instead! More details in the patch notes!

[h3]And more! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3040560/view/515211349279639204]Be sure to read the patch notes[/url] for more detailed information![/h3]

This update ended up being a lot bigger than expected, but I hope you'll enjoy the changes and additions! If you've got any feedback or suggestions, feel free to let me know in the discussions or through a review!

So what's next? In addition to possible bug fix or balance patches, development will be focusing on the next [b]Extra Stage[/b]! I think it will be more interesting to keep the content for this one a surprise, but hopefully you won't have to wait too long. After that, work will begin on [b]Stage 3C[/b], completing the third stage tier! Hoping to share more info soon!

notes.title: Progress Report!
notes.content:
It's been just over a month since Elite Exorcist Miko entered Early Access, and once again, thank you for playing! There have been several updates since then, including the addition of Easy Mode and various balancing changes. Behind all that though, we've been hard at work cooking up content for the upcoming [b]Makai Stage[/b], or Stage 3B! Not only will this update include 4 new bosses to battle, on par with those in Medieval Stage, but it'll also come with 13 new equipment items to open up even more ways to play! We're hoping to have this update ready sometime in April. Here's a rough breakdown of the progress so far:
[list]
[*][b]Equipment Items[/b]: DONE! All new items have been implemented and are fully functional!
[*][b]Stage[/b]: Background and enemy art in progress
[*][b]Bosses[/b]: Art and dialogue in progress
[*][b]Music[/b]: Pending
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/f5738c2c63a1440911d8cde1dd4feabdc6a4e052.png[/img]
Minor balance and bug fix updates will continue to be released in the interim. I want to do my best to not break existing strategies, so don't expect too many huge changes to existing bosses and equipment. Some notes on specific items:
[list]
[*][b]Lightning Streamers[/b]: I'm well aware of the strategy of building up maximum charges to deal damage high enough to clear Phases in an instant. While I've received some suggestions to nerf this item, I've decided for the time being to keep it as is, as I think the time needed to use this strategy is enough of a counterbalance. There will also be items to be added in the future that encourage more frequent use of Heavy Attacks.
[*][b]Whiteout Blizzard / Thousand Flames[/b]: When used together with certain items, these Scrolls can trivialize Shrine Sweep far into the hundreds of waves. Whiteout Blizzard's boost from Retro Gamepad or Heat Treatment is also disproportionately big in comparison to boosts for other items. These will receive some nerfs in a future update, but not in ways that will impact their viability too much in regular play outside of Shrine Sweep. The current plan is to dynamically decrease their effectiveness as enemy count increases.
[/list]
As always, feel free to leave any feedback and suggestions you have in reviews or discussions, it helps out a lot! I'll do my best to read everything, even if in languages other than English!

As an aside, I'm looking forward to 6th fes.! Wonder what kind of flip Korone'll pull off this year 🤔

notes.title: Upcoming Changes + Dev Roadmap!
notes.content:
[b]Happy New Year![/b]

It's been almost a week since the Early Access release of Elite Exorcist Miko, and so first of all, a big thank you to all players! I've received a ton of feedback, and I'm itching to jump back into development and start working on more content for you to enjoy! But first, I'd like to share plans for a smaller update that will hopefully be ready around a week from now. 

Here's a list of upcoming changes:
[list]
[*][b]Easy Mode![/b] I've thought a lot about this, and ultimately I think this will be a necessary addition in order for more people to be able to enjoy the main story. Many people are new to bullet hells, and while there are ways for players to make things easier, some may not be immediately evident. The current plan for Easy Mode is to lower enemy and boss projectile quantity, and increase healing and invincibility time (on hit or Scroll use). Boss crowns and certain achievements will not be obtainable in Easy Mode, and Extra Stages will not be accessible as they are intended to be optional, difficult fights.
[*][b]Better drops![/b] Obtaining materials and Holo Essence to craft equipment and make offerings is currently a fairly slow process, and players may feel frustrated when Holo Essence drops instead of a material they're looking for. While using Simple Sealing speeds up the process, I don't want players to feel forced to use it purely for grinding. The plan is to split material and Holo Essence drops in Main Expeditions so that neither has a chance of replacing the other, and also increase the total drop amount in the process.
[*][b]Alternative way to obtain Cosplays![/b] Currently, cosplays are locked behind boss crowns, which may be frustrating for players who are not interested in no-hitting a boss but would nevertheless like her outfit. With the coming update, boss cosplays will be purchasable using their respective Seals! They will still remain obtainable the current way, and Extra Stage boss cosplays will be exempt from this method.
[/list]
That sums up the changes for the next update! But what about the overall content plan? That's where this roadmap comes in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/d0c21c12d029d2598dc28a4c9997df4d9b90f7da.png[/img]
This is the general outline for content planned all the way up to the full release! Do note that the listed release times are estimates and are subject to change. A major update will be made for each Main Expedition stage, with new enemies, 1 midboss and 3-4 bosses, and an assortment of new items. Extra Stages will be implemented in smaller updates in-between, and will each feature a special gimmick that sets them apart from other battles.

To give you a hint of what's to come, I'll reveal the name of the next stage in development: [b]Makai Stage[/b]! Try to guess which [i]hololive[/i] members you might encounter here!

Once again, thank you for playing! If you've got any suggestions or feedback, feel free to leave a review or discussion topic! I'll try my best to read everything!

notes.title: Now In Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148406/b18b383ccc9398bdbae5fe00adca023ae1bc478a.png[/img]

After over 2 years in development, I'm very happy to announce that [b][i]Elite Exorcist Miko[/i][/b] is finally available in Early Access! Lots of things have happened during that time, including the introduction of holo Indie, which has been very helpful in making even more things possible for this game! With the current state of the game, you'll have 6 stages (spread across 3 stage tiers), over 20 bosses, and 90 equipment items to enjoy! If you'd like to take a break from bosses, you can also play the Shrine Sweep mode to mow down endless waves of enemies!

I'd like to thank all the friends and contributors who have assisted with assets, translations and playtesting; this game would not be here right now without their help! And of course, a big thank you to everyone who played the demo released back in August. I've received a lot of feedback and suggestions, some of which I've already been able to act on!

Speaking of holo Indie, if you play [b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825180/WOWOWOW_KORONE_BOX/]WOWOWOW KORONE BOX[/url][/i][/b] and collect a total of 50 boxes, you'll receive something cool in this game! It's free, so definitely go for it if you'd like to!


[h2]So what's next?[/h2]
First, a small break for me.

Once we enter 2025, I'll continue working on new content while balancing existing stuff and making sure everything's still working. So what's in store?

[h3]MORE STAGES, MORE BOSSES, MORE ITEMS![/h3]
This will be the main focus as we proceed through Early Access. While I can't guarantee I'll be able to get to everyone, I'd like to add much more [i]hololive[/i] members to battle against, and along with them even more stages and equipment! I already have plans for them outlined, and I'm hoping to have updates for each new stage and set of bosses every several months or so. I'll make a follow-up post sometime later with a more detailed roadmap to show you what I have planned!

[h3]Making the game more beginner friendly![/h3]
Bullet hell is traditionally a pretty intimidating genre, and while there are already a lot of in-game options for beginners such as Assist Options, Offerings and certain equipment items, I understand that this game can still be pretty tough, especially with the focus on melee combat and several additional mechanics. I'm considering adding an Easy Mode or something equivalent to help ease newer players into the gameplay, and maybe more Assist Options as well.


I hope you'll enjoy everything that Elite Exorcist Miko has to offer, now and in the future! Thank you for playing!
